title: Licence inventory of the 39 submodules and FidelityFX-FSR
description: Upstream is GPL-2.0-only. GitHub's licence API identifies only some submodules (e.g. SDL Zlib, SPIRV-Tools Apache-2.0, VulkanMemoryAllocator MIT, ffmpeg-core LGPL-2.1, libusb-cmake LGPL-2.1, mimalloc MIT); many are NOASSERTION, libressl/openbsd returned 404, and pixman, cairo and libyuv are not on GitHub. Read the licence file at each pinned submodule SHA and flag combinations to check for GPL-2.0-only compatibility (notably Apache-2.0 and the LibreSSL/OpenSSL-family licences).
acceptance: Table: submodule, pinned SHA, licence file path, SPDX identifier
Potential GPL-2.0-only incompatibilities listed for human (legal) review, without conclusions stated as fact
Licences of the submodules' own nested submodules checked, or noted as not checked
